questions.stem: 提示：為了讓社區居民有運動的地方，有些學校在放學後開放操場，讓附近居民晚上進校園散步、慢跑。請比較下列兩張圖，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段比較圖一與圖二中操場的情形有何不同；第二段說明你是否贊成學校晚上開放操場給居民使用，並提出理由支持你的看法。

1.explanation_zh: 第一段要「比較」兩張圖的不同，重點是同一個操場在晚上熱鬧、隔天早上留下垃圾與損壞的對照；第二段要先表明是否贊成晚上開放操場，再提出理由。不論贊成或反對，都要面對圖二呈現的問題：贊成的話說明怎麼避免，反對的話說明為什麼難以避免。
evidence: 第一段比較圖一與圖二中操場的情形有何不同
第二段說明你是否贊成學校晚上開放操場給居民使用
並提出理由支持你的看法
1.strategy_zh: 圖二裡「幾步外就有垃圾桶」是很好用的細節：它說明問題不在設備不夠，而在使用者的習慣，可以接到第二段的規則或宣導。
hints: 第一段：把兩張圖放在一起，逐項對照人、垃圾與草地
第二段前半：表態後寫兩個理由，其中一個配合自己或家人的經驗
第二段後半：回應圖二的問題，提出一個具體的做法

moves.zh: 比較圖一與圖二中操場的情形有何不同
說明你是否贊成學校晚上開放操場給居民使用

content.focus_zh: 第一段要對照兩張圖：圖一傍晚燈光下慢跑、踢球、散步的居民，圖二隔天早上留在跑道旁的飲料杯與塑膠袋、被踩壞的草地，以及皺眉的學生和不遠處的垃圾桶，不是兩張圖各描述一次；第二段要明確表態（贊成、反對或有條件贊成），並提出至少兩個理由，可以用自己或家人的經驗、具體做法支持。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段用 In Picture 1…, In Picture 2, by contrast… 或 while、whereas 把兩張圖放在一起對照；第二段先表態，再依序寫理由，可以先承認圖二的問題再提出解決方法，結尾回扣自己的立場。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在進行式與現在完成式（has been worn away），表態可以用 I think／I support＋V-ing；注意 as long as、even though 帶出的子句要完整，被動語態不要漏掉 be 動詞。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 操場與運動相關用語（sports field、track、jog、take a walk、residents、neighbors、litter、trash can）要用得準；避免整段只用 people、good、bad 這幾個字。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

outline.topic_sentence_zh: 兩張圖呈現同一個操場在晚上與隔天早上的不同樣貌。

outline.topic_sentence_zh: 表明你是否贊成晚上開放操場。
details_zh: 理由一：居民需要安全、免費的運動空間
理由二：自己或家人使用學校操場的經驗，或開放能拉近學校與社區
圖二的問題怎麼解決：規則、垃圾桶、志工或使用者自律

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The two pictures show the same school sports field at two different times. In Picture 1, it is early evening, and some neighbors have come to exercise under the lights. Two adults are jogging on the track, a father is playing soccer with his little daughter on the grass, and an old man is taking a walk. Everyone looks relaxed. In Picture 2, by contrast, the field looks different the next morning. Four drink cups and a plastic bag are lying beside the track, and part of the grass has been worn away. A student in sportswear is frowning at the mess, even though there is a trash can only a few steps away.
In my opinion, schools should keep their sports fields open to neighbors at night. First, many people in cities have no safe place to exercise after work. A school field is free, flat, and well lit, so it is perfect for jogging and walking. Second, sharing the field can bring the school and the community closer. For example, my grandmother and I often walk around the field of an elementary school near our home after dinner, and she has made several new friends there. However, the problem in Picture 2 cannot be ignored. Therefore, schools should post clear rules and provide more trash cans, and neighbors should take their trash home. In short, opening the field is a good idea as long as users respect it.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 第一段逐項對照兩張圖（居民的活動、垃圾、草地、皺眉的學生與垃圾桶），第二段立場明確，兩個理由配合和祖母散步的經驗，並回應圖二的問題（內容 4）；by contrast、First、Second、However、Therefore、In short 等轉承清楚（組織 4）；句子正確，有現在完成式被動與 keep＋受詞＋形容詞（文法句構 4）；用字正確但偏基本，trash、field 重複（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
Seen at two different times, the same school sports field tells two very different stories. In the first picture, taken in the early evening, the floodlights are on and the field belongs to the neighborhood. Two adults are jogging side by side along the track, and a father is kicking a ball back and forth with his little daughter on the grass. Meanwhile, an elderly man with white hair is strolling around the outer lane. The atmosphere is relaxed, almost like that of a public park. By the next morning, however, the mood has changed completely. Four empty drink cups and a plastic bag lie scattered beside the track, and a patch of grass in the middle has been trampled down to bare soil. A student in sportswear stands frowning at the mess, which seems even more annoying because a trash can is only a few steps away.
Despite the litter, I support opening school fields to residents at night, as long as the arrangement comes with clear rules. In crowded cities, safe and free places to exercise are surprisingly hard to find. Many commuters get home after dark, and parks near main roads are often noisy and full of traffic fumes. A school field, by contrast, is flat, well lit, and already paid for with public money, so leaving it empty every evening seems like a waste. My grandmother is a case in point: since an elementary school near our apartment began opening its field, she and I have walked there almost every evening, and her doctor says her blood pressure has improved. Admittedly, the second picture reveals a genuine cost. Students should not have to begin their day by picking up other people's cups, and damaged grass costs money to repair. Yet closing the gate would punish the many for the carelessness of a few. A more sustainable solution would be to post a short list of rules at the entrance, add more trash cans, and invite local volunteers to patrol the field before the gate closes at night. In this way, the field can serve the whole community while remaining a clean place for students to learn and play.

paragraphs.function_zh: 比較兩張圖：圖一燈光下的居民各自運動，圖二留下的垃圾與被踩壞的草地，並點出垃圾桶就在旁邊
paragraphs.topic_sentence: Seen at two different times, the same school sports field tells two very different stories.

notes.zh: 過去分詞片語補充說明

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 第一段逐項對照兩張圖並以「同一個操場、兩個故事」統整；第二段先有條件地表態，從城市缺乏運動空間、公共資源不該閒置兩個理由切入，以祖母血壓改善的經驗佐證，讓步承認圖二的代價，再以「不該因少數人而懲罰多數人」反駁，提出規則、垃圾桶與志工巡視的具體做法（內容 5）；對比、讓步、反駁、結論層次清楚（組織 5）；分詞構句、非限定關係子句、現在完成式被動皆正確（文法句構 5）；用字精確（residents、fumes、trampled），整體仍以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

top.comment_zh: 第一段以 Seen at two different times 開頭，真正把兩圖對照（By the next morning, however），細節完整：照明燈、慢跑、父女踢球、白髮老先生散步、飲料杯與塑膠袋、草地踩壞、皺眉學生與近在幾步外的垃圾桶。第二段有條件贊成，理由包括城市缺少安全免費的運動場所、公帑已支付的場地閒置可惜、祖母血壓改善的親身經驗，再讓步承認圖二的代價並提出具體做法，首尾呼應。句型與字彙高階且無誤。

steady.comment_zh: 以 In Picture 1 … In Picture 2, by contrast 對照兩圖，要素齊全；第二段明確贊成，兩個理由（缺少運動場所、拉近學校與社區）並以祖母交到朋友為例，再承認圖二問題、提出規則與垃圾桶的做法，結尾回扣立場。文法無誤；even though 一句的讓步邏輯略鬆但可理解。字彙正確但較基本（looks different、good idea），屬穩健程度。

top.comment_zh: 第一段以「同一個操場、兩種故事」帶出對照，圖一的慢跑、踢球、散步與圖二的杯子、塑膠袋、被踩壞的草地、皺眉的學生與近在咫尺的垃圾桶都寫到，但比較方式仍偏兩圖依序描述；第二段明確表態（有條件贊成），有祖母散步的經驗、承認圖二的代價並提出具體做法，結尾回扣立場。語言幾乎無瑕。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段用 In Picture 1 與 In Picture 2, by contrast 對照，細節齊全，但差異說明較淺；第二段先表態，再以兩個理由、祖母交朋友的經驗，並承認圖二問題後提出規則與垃圾桶的做法。文法正確、結構清楚，句型偏簡單；even though 帶出的句子語意略不順，但不構成文法錯誤。
